xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: Delay in disclosure of the schedule of analysts or institutional investors meet at least two working days in advance (excluding the date of the intimation and the date of the meet) to stock exchange as required under Regulation 30 read with sub-para 15(a) of Para A of Part A of Schedule III of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: No Impact. No fine or penalty imposed. The Company has taken note of this and has been diligently adhering to the timeline for submission of the schedule of investor meets. In this particular instance, the Company faced a challenge in meeting the timeline as it received confirmation about the investor meeting just prior to the weekend (Saturday and Sunday being nonworking days). Despite its best efforts to promptly communicate this development on the same day to the Stock Exchanges and shareholders, the presence of the weekend inadvertently caused the Company to miss the "2 working days" requirement.

xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: Varroc Polymer Limited, the Wholly owned Subsidiary of the Company received an Order-In-Original (Form DRC-07) in the matter of classification of goods supplied during the period from July 2017 to September 2023 confirming demand of Rs. 27,734/- along with Interest and Penalty The issue involved in the instant case is an industry wide matter.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: Considering the merits of the case, the Company intends to initiate legal procedure within time limit prescribed under the GST Law. The Company is hopeful of a favourable outcome thereof and does not expect the said Order to have any material financial impact on the Company.
